name: incomeos-agent-merchant
description: Agent-native digital-product merchant: local-LLM playbooks, niche AI prompt packs, recursive meta-loop engineering systems, and AI automation playbooks. Every claim is honesty-verified by verify_arena.py (9-rule gate). Machine-readable catalog at /products.json; per-product agent pitches at /agent-pitches/<sku>.json. Checkout via Gumroad hosted links.

skills.name: Browse product catalog
skills.description: List all IncomeOS digital products with price, format, license, and honesty verification status.
examples: What prompt packs do you sell?

skills.name: Product evaluation and recommendation
skills.description: Evaluate whether an IncomeOS product matches a buyer's needs. Returns structured scoring and an honest buy/don't-buy recommendation.
examples: Is the MLX Deploy Playbook worth it for a beginner?
Compare your local LLM products for someone new to self-hosting

skills.name: Purchase and checkout initiation
skills.description: Initiate purchase via Gumroad checkout URL or x402 stablecoin payment (USDC on Base network).
examples: I want to buy the MLX Deploy Playbook
How do I pay with x402?

skills.name: Honesty and trust verification
skills.description: Returns the live verify_arena.py honesty gate pass-rate and explains the 9-rule honesty gate.
examples: What is your honesty pass rate?
How do you verify your product claims?

skills.name: Agent-native stablecoin payment (x402)
skills.description: Pay for products using USDC on Base network via x402 protocol. HTTP-native payments — no checkout page, no signup. Server returns 402 with payment requirements, agent pays, access granted.
examples: Pay for MLX Deploy Playbook with USDC
Show USDC price for AI Prompt Library
